items.t: Medical Properties Trust: 22% Yield? Not According To The Chart
items.sum: Analyst rates MPT a Hold: Q3 normalized FFO fell to $0.11, while 8.7x leverage and an uncovered dividend outweigh its 22.64% yield.

items.t: Buried Treasures: 6 Strong, Undervalued High-Yield REITs
items.sum: The bull case for REITs: six candidates are at least 20% undervalued, yield 75 bps above the risk-free rate and pass dividend-safety tests.

items.t: Treasuries Now Yield 5.1%. These High-Yield Dividend Stocks Could Be in Trouble
items.sum: With Treasuries paying real money and zero stock risk, four big yields face a harsh test. One of them still shows up on screens even though the checks stopped years ago. Which payouts can survive, and which are already gone?
